[B5]

[Verse 1]
[B5]You come around every
now and then.
Your clothes are different, But you're
still the same. [E5/B]
Why else would you
come here? [E5]
Scumbag on a
mission. [B5]
You're telling me that it's
been a while.
Shiteating grin and a
brand new life. [E5/B]
Somebody let you
come here. [E5]
Scumbag with per-
mission. [G#5]

[Chorus]
[G#5]Never thought I'd see the
like of you around this [B5]place.
[G#5]
What's the special oc-
casion? Did you [F#5]
run out of
friends? [B5]

[Verse 2]
[B5]Hear you are comin'
'round again,
And things are different but you
still pretend. [E5/B]
You got a reason to
come here. [E5]
Scumbag with am-
bition. [B5]
And now you're telling me that
things have changed,
And you'll be leaving in a
couple days. [E5/B]
You're gonna change the
world someday. [E5]
Scumbag with a
vision. [G#5]

[Chorus]
[G#5]It must be nice to know you
got it all figured [B5]out,
[G#5]
But from where I'm
sitting, It's the [F#5]
same thing a-
gain and a-
gain.
[B5]

[Guitar Solo]
[B5]
[E5/B]
[E5]
[B5]
[E5/B]
[E5]
[G#5]

[Outro]
[G#5]Did you ever stop to think Be-
fore you opened up your [B5]mouth?
[G#5]
'Cause everytime you
do, It's the [F#5]
same thing a-
gain and a-
gain.
title: Scumbag
